name: materialhack-novacore
description: Codex-operated protein-design workflow for Novacore memory, guarded loop lifecycle, TRS, Boltz, and verifier loops.

interface.longDescription: MaterialHack Novacore gives Codex a harnessed protein-design workflow: WF-style seed selection, durable loop memory, guarded one-candidate loop lifecycle, TRS scoring, Boltz setup/preflight, per-user Boltz API key prompting, verifier evidence, reject/rollback, branch provenance, and a memory workbench UI.
